sloka: सा सेना शक्रयुक्तेव नगरान्निर्ययावथ ।राघवानुगता दूरं दुराधर्षा सुरैरपि ।। ७.१००.२१ ॥
transliteration: sā senā śakrayukteva nagarānniryayāvatha ।rāghavānugatā dūraṁ durādharṣā surairapi ।। 7.100.21 ॥

translations.english: That army, as if accompanied by Indra, then departed far from the city, following Bharata, and was unconquerable even by the gods.
